CERTIFICATE OF UNEMPLOYMENT

This certificate is to certify that

T H U N D E R 

has been currently identified as unemployed. "Thunder", an element of natural phenomena, symbolizes strength and mayhem. Although it's invisible, its sound communicates its presence and power.

This certificate also acknowledges the strength of Thunder in the state of unemployment and encourages the unsettling forces to harness it productive and constructive potential.
